title: Transgender Day of Remembrance Events
description: 10 events across the city that raise awareness and honor those who have been killed as a result of anti-transgender violence: vigils in the Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens; a discussion at Stonewall National Monument on how to protect transgender and non-binary individuals from anti-trans laws; and more.

title: 32nd Annual Harlem Holiday Lights
description: The 125th Street BID kicks off the season with the annual Harlem Holiday Lights, a parade of more than 20 illuminated floats and vehicles from community organizations. This year’s grand marshal is actor and philanthropist Malik Yoba.

title: Miller Theater’s Pop-Up Concert Series
description: The Columbia University School of the Arts’s musical happy hour returns for a new season of hour-long concerts where the audience is permitted to sit onstage with the performers and enjoy a free drink. This week, Treble-voice quartet Quince Ensemble returns with a program of works from their recent studio album Dust Bowl.

title: Traveling: On the Path with Joni Mitchell
description: NPR music critic Ann Powers discusses her 2024 biography Traveling: On the Path with Joni Mitchell at CUNY Graduate Center (Midtown).

title: Russ + Daughters: 100 Years of Appetizing
description: Fourth generation Russ + Daughters co-owners Niki Russ Federman and Josh Russ present their new cookbook Russ + Daughters: 100 Years of Appetizing in conversation with writer and restaurant critic Joshua David Stein.

title: Nate Berkus, Jeremiah Brent, Tyler Cameron and More Design a Night of Fun at Symphony Space
description: The worlds of design, comedy, literature, and pop culture collide for one night only as Nate Berkus brings Jeremiah Brent, Tyler Cameron, writer and comedian Jessi Klein, and NPR radio personality Emma Choi to the Symphony Space stage for a playful evening of games, readings, and conversation celebrating his new book, Foundations.

title: 2025 National Book Awards Finalists Reading
description: The National Book Foundation and NYU Creative Writing Program present an evening of readings by each of the 2025 National Book Award finalists in fiction, nonfiction, poetry, young people’s literature, and translated literature.

title: The Vinyl Word Music Book Club
description: Dive into the 33 1/3 book series at this music-minded book club, where each session spotlights a classic album and the short book written about it. Tonight's pick is Patti Smith's Horses (50th anniversary!) with a full album listen followed by DJ sets.

title: Brooklyn Books + Booze
description: Hear established and up-and-coming authors of different genres read from their current works every third Tuesday of the month at Barrow's Intense Tasting Room (Industry City).

title: Astronomy on Tap: ‘Galaxies and Government’ Edition
description: Things are looking up at Astronomy on Tap, a night where astronomy enthusiasts gather at a local bar for talks by professional scientists and educators—plus themed games and other cosmic fun.

title: The Broad Squad
description: Kendra Cunningham presents a monthly comedy variety show featuring a female-fronted lineup and tarot readings.

title: Animation Nights New York
description: Watch a curated program of animated short films from around the world at this monthly screening event.

title: Sweet Comedy Show: ‘Sweets-Giving’ Edition
description: Seth Herzog’s long-running comedy show returns with guests Erica Rhodes, Marina Franklin, Pete Lee, and more.

title: Fielding Edlow: Gaslighting is My Love Language
description: Fresh off an international tour, comedian and writer Fielding Edlow brings her one-woman show about being gaslit for 13 years by a character actor husband to NYC.
